_source: Writers' Room task 20261110_2241_absinthe_arcade_microcopy, approved as final by the author 2026-11-11 (desk, 'Approve as final'). Copied verbatim; WritingRoom/ is untracked.

token_attendant.use: ambient mutters when the bros walk near him; to himself and the machines

ticket_machine: Gulp it down, teeth-face. Spit orange or get the mallet.
Always the left hip. Just like my auntie.
Stop chewing the perforation. You don't even have a liver.
Eat the ribbon, then cry about it. Every night.
Two hundred tickets stuck in your throat. Choke on 'em.
You're getting three teeth knocked out if you don't spit.
token_machine: One SOV, one token. Don't look at me, calculate it.
Swallow the bill, burp the brass. That’s our sacred covenant.
Clack-clack-clack. Music of an honest robbery.
Cough up the metal, slag-bucket. Don't make me kick the coin-slot.
Keep twenty percent. Management said it's called shrinkage.
Empty again? Somebody's college fund just went in your gut.
restrooms: How do you miss porcelain from two inches away? Explain physics.
Mop the green puddle. Don't smell the green puddle. Never look.
Someone tried flushing a whole döner wrap again. Savage.
Three wing-feathers left on the bronze lady. Don't touch her.
Two rolls on her arm. That's luxury. That's hospitality.
Bleach doesn't fix this. Only fire fixes this.
claw_machines: Grease the claw hinge. If it grips, I lose my job.
Pack the plushies tight. No air between the bears. Suffocate 'em.
Tension at four percent. Exactly enough to break a child's heart.
Another fake Beanie Baby. Still smells like the shipping container.
Grip, slip, drop. That's the trilogy. Beautiful.
Snoop Bear looks sad today. Too bad. Back in the glass.
shift: Thirty-seven buttons. Thirty-eight if you count the blister under my collar.
Green tongue again. Bartender says it's just European vitamins.
Ask me about tokens. Go on. Read the button. Suffer.
If I pop this zit, the mirror's gonna need a wiper.
Four more hours till the fairy holds me. Just four.
Candy stripes don't show vomit. Good company policy.

late_night_after_0100: The bronze wings are warm tonight. She knows my name.
Two tokens for the roll... one token for a dream...
Floor's tilting north. Good. Gravity does the mopping.
Which button has my address on it? None of 'em.
Anise in my teeth... tokens in my socks... livin' large.

ddr_expert.use: selecting EASY bounces back to EXPERT; per bro

lord_pilsner: The arrow bounced back. Euro-trash arcade chip is intimidated by my calf-game.
Hold left! The machine’s rigged for locals with bird-bone ankles.
Bro, the select button is stuck on Communist. It refuses democracy.
Expert? Fine. I danced at Alpha Sigma semi-formals. Stand back.
Hit it harder. The metric system is fighting my thumbs.
It skipped Easy because it recognized prime pedigree. Classic Debaucheryville hospitality.
chadwick: Yo, the UI just glitched back up! This firmware is literally third-world.
Chat, the sensor knows I’m verified. It’s forcing the sweat-tier content.
The pad has input lag from 1999! My bandwidth is getting choked out!
It won’t let me set Novice! That’s an algorithmic hate crime!
Dude, it's trapped on Expert mode! That's bad for viewer retention!
Bounced again! Somebody hacked this cabinet with underground techno malware!
bradley: Button’s jammed. Some greasy Euro spilled döner sauce in the Easy-slot.
It locked on Expert. My quads are ready. Floor’s about to crack.
The spring is stiff! This whole platform needs fifty pounds of lithium grease.
Bounced down? Nah, it bounced UP. Machine wants a real heavyweight.
Easy is for cardio-dodgers. The steel pad senses my mass.
Don't tap it, kick it! It's disrespecting my vertical leap!

lord_pilsner: The song sped up right when I peaked. Unlicensed Dutch sabotage.
My loafers have zero traction on these unpolished metal plates. Clean your floor!
That wasn't four-four time. That was irregular continental tavern tempo. Scam.
chadwick: The frame rate dropped during my power-spin! Check the stream replay!
That down-arrow was off-beat! The DJ probably stole that remix off LimeWire!
Failed? The screen crashed because my finishing freeze-pose was too hot for pixel-art!
bradley: Pad’s calibrated for a hundred-and-forty-pound twinks. I punched through the sensor!
I didn't fail. The plywood beneath the steel gave out under peak torque.
Song pulled a muscle. I was just getting into my warm-up stretch.
